title: Request for Proposal RFP-PR462809 Peptide Synthesizer
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ORNL UT-BATTELLE LLC-DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: UT-Battelle, LLC (the Company), is the Management & Operations contractor for the Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) located in Oak Ridge, TN. The Company is seeking proposals for the delivery of one (1) Peptide Synthesizer in support of a Department of Energy (DOE) funded project. A RFQ462809 Bill of Materials for the Peptide Synthesizer is provided in Attachment D listing the components of the synthesizer. All quotes/proposals should adhere to the criteria outlined therein.
